description: List the owner's Google reviews, newest first, with each review's id, star rating, text and any existing reply. Unanswered reviews are listed first by default. Use a review id with propose_review_reply. Write replies yourself in the owner's voice: two or three sentences, thank them for something specific, never offer discounts or ask for a better rating.

only_unanswered.description: Only reviews without a reply. Default true.

name: my_reviews
title: This owner's Google reviews, and which still need a reply
